# Retrieval ablation

*Generated by `scripts/retrieval_ablation.py`. Gold set: 13 papers, 48 fields present in the paper. No language model involved.*

recall@k: share of present fields whose gold value is inside the top-k passages. In brackets: 95% bootstrap interval over fields. Context: words in the 3 passages sent to the student (median / max); prompt: system + user message in student tokens (median / max), when the tokenizer is available.

| BM25 | sections ≤ 150 w | 0.62 | 0.90 [0.79 – 0.98] | 0.90 | 0.96 | 425 / 492 | — | 57 |
